name: create_file
description: Create or overwrite a text file (relative to sandbox.work_dir). UTF-8 code/config only; do not write large binaries.
returns: (ok, message). success message. Triggers the on_edit_apply_request confirmation hook.

name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a text file inside the sandbox. Suggest reading right after create_file / edit_file to verify the result.
returns: (ok, message). message is the file contents (size-limited, ~64KB).

name: modify_file
description: Equivalent to create_file: write a file by overwriting. Triggers on_edit_apply_request so the user can diff.

name: mark_delete
description: Mark a file as pending deletion (equivalent to delete_file; the safety semantics mean it is not removed immediately). After execution the file enters the pending-delete list.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file inside the sandbox. Shares implementation with mark_delete.

name: list_files
description: List all files under the current project working directory (recursively). no parameters.
returns: (ok, message). message is an indented file list.

name: backup_workspace
description: Create a timestamped backup of the whole workspace (as an archive). Optionally pass a label to distinguish backups.

name: update_ds_section
description: Update a section in DS.md (the project documentation file). Supports description / pending / completed / custom.

fields.example: 重构登录模块，提高可维护性

name: add_task
description: Append a task to the pending task list.

fields.example: 为 login 模块添加单元测试

name: complete_task
description: Move a task from the pending list to the completed list.

fields.example: 为 login 模块添加单元测试

name: web_search
description: Issue a keyword query to an external search engine; returns a list of titles / snippets / URLs. Must not be used to query sensitive data.
returns: (ok, message). message is formatted search results.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch the HTML/text contents of a public URL (read with SSR protection), used to retrieve public documentation. Private addresses are rejected.

fields.note: default False; even when True the SSR protection policy will be checked

returns: (ok, message). message is the sanitized HTML text (size-limited).

name: http_request
description: Make an HTTP/HTTPS request; returns status code, headers, and response body (with a max bytes cap). Used to test self-built APIs.

name: docs_lookup
description: Search official documentation of common programming languages by keyword; returns a small number of relevant paragraphs.

name: run_command
description: Execute a synchronous command inside the sandbox (blocks until finished). Restricted by a dangerous-command blocklist (e.g. rm -rf /, sudo, chmod 777, etc.).
returns: (ok, message). message is the merged stdout+stderr (size-limited).

name: run_command_stream
description: Streaming version of run_command, allowing the on_output_line callback to consume output line by line.

name: calculator
description: Safe expression calculator (no eval/exec; AST-based whitelist evaluation). Supports +-*/ and parentheses.
returns: (ok, message). message is the computed result string.

name: execute_custom
description: Run a user-defined script (shell/python/nodejs). Requires external authorization; protected by the command blocklist.

name: mcp_call
description: Invoke a registered MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool. Available tools are provided by the external manager.

name: mcp_list
description: List all configured MCP servers, their enabled/running status and available tool count.

name: mcp_add
description: Add or update an MCP server configuration. You may use this to register a new MCP server by yourself.

fields.note: default false; use mcp_start to run

name: mcp_remove
description: Remove an MCP server configuration by name.

name: mcp_enable
description: Enable or disable an MCP server configuration (persists config, does not start/stop process).

name: mcp_start
description: Start an MCP server process and register its tools. Requires the server to be added and enabled first.

name: mcp_stop
description: Stop a running MCP server process and unregister its tools.

name: exit_conversation
description: Proactively signal 'end this turn' to the outside; the model may attach a reason. Does not terminate the process.

name: create_snapshot
description: Create a snapshot (versioned backup) of the current working directory.

fields.example: 重构 login 之前的工作状态

name: restore_snapshot
description: Roll the working directory back to a snapshot state; uncommitted local changes will be overwritten — please confirm first.

name: list_snapshots
description: List all snapshots already created under this project. no parameters.

name: undo_last
description: Undo the most recent file change or roll back N steps.

name: delegate_subagent
description: Delegate a task description to a sub-agent; the sub-agent has its own tool-call loop and returns aggregated results when finished.

fields.example: 为 src/login.py 生成单元测试，覆盖率 >= 80%，并在 tests/ 中生成对应文件。

returns: (ok, message). message is the sub-agent's final report.

name: start_subagent
description: Start a background sub-agent (asynchronous). Results can later be polled via get_subagent_results.

fields.example: 扫描整个项目的 TODO/FIXME 并做汇总。

name: list_subagents
description: List currently running / completed sub-agents. no parameters.

name: get_subagent_results
description: Retrieve the latest output from a sub-agent (including status and text result).

name: stop_subagent
description: Send a stop signal to a sub-agent, asking it to exit before the next tool-call point.

name: ask_user_questions
description: Pop up a GUI asking the user one or more questions and wait for a reply; used to clarify requirements.

example: 这个配置应该放在哪个环境？
默认值使用 8080 可以吗？

returns: (ok, message). message is a JSON-array string of the user's ordered answers.

name: search_code
description: Search code lines inside the sandbox by keyword / regex; filterable by extension, and returns context lines.

fields.note: number of surrounding context lines to show

name: find_symbol
description: Search for a definition by symbol name (function/class/variable). Not AST-parsed; based on literal matching — useful for rough positioning.

name: find_files
description: List matching project files by glob pattern (shell wildcards).

name: find_todo
description: Search for all lines in the project containing TODO. no parameters.

name: find_fixme
description: Search for all lines in the project containing FIXME. no parameters.

name: edit_file
description: Perform a precise 'old text -> new text' replacement inside a file. The old text must match exactly.

fields.example:
def hello(name: str = 'world') -> str:
    return f'hi {name}'

name: insert_lines
description: Insert multiple lines of text after a specified line number.

name: delete_lines
description: Delete a contiguous range of lines in a file (from_line to to_line, both endpoints inclusive).

name: replace_in_files
description: Perform a global find -> replace by literal text across all files matching the extension. Case-sensitive.
returns: (ok, message). includes list of affected files.

name: rename_symbol
description: Rename by symbol name (cross-file lookup); based on literal replacement, not semantic renaming.
returns: (ok, message). includes list of affected files.

name: analyze_file
description: Analyze a single file's byte count, line count, and non-empty lines, and return a condensed view of the file contents.

name: find_imports
description: Extract the list of import / from ... import statements in a file.

name: show_call_chain
description: Starting from an entry symbol, display the call chain (currently an approximate chain based on literal matching).

name: code_metrics
description: Return code-wide metrics (file count, line count, extension statistics, etc.). no parameters.

name: show_dependencies
description: Display an overview of third-party modules imported by the project. no parameters.

name: run_tests
description: Run the project's test scripts (e.g. pytest, npm test, etc.). Scope (subdirectory) and pattern (match test files) can be specified.
returns: (ok, message). message is the test execution output.

name: lint_code
description: Run lint on a list of specified files (default pyflakes).

name: check_types
description: Run type checking on specified Python files (based on mypy).

name: format_code
description: Run automatic formatting on specified Python files (based on black/similar tools).

name: project_brief
description: Generate a short summary of the whole project: file count, line count, dominant languages, and directory structure. no parameters.

name: file_intel
description: Generate an 'intelligence' summary for a single file: list of functions/classes, import dependencies, quick code-style scan.

name: find_related
description: Find other files related to the specified file / symbol (based on import / naming similarity).

name: analyze_symbol
description: Deep analysis around a symbol: definition position, call sites, typical parameters / returns.

name: impact_analysis
description: Change-impact analysis for a target file: which other modules would be affected by changes to this file.

name: all_symbols
description: List all symbols (classes/functions) across the whole project (roughly, based on literal matching). no parameters.

name: complexity_report
description: Roughly estimate line-based complexity per file and output a ranking. no parameters.

name: risk_files
description: Return a list of 'risk files': files with high line count / high TODO/FIXME density / recently frequently modified. no parameters.

name: codebase_search
description: Semantic search across the codebase using a lightweight TF-IDF vector index. Use this when keyword search is not enough and you need to find relevant code snippets by natural language description.

fields.example: where is the user authentication logic

fields.note: number of results to return (1-20, default 8)

returns: (ok, message). includes file paths, line ranges, similarity scores and snippets.

name: validate_all
description: Run a quick syntax / structural validation pass on all analyzable files in the project.

name: validate_file
description: Run structural validation on a single file (Python: AST compilation; JSON/XML/YAML: parsing).

name: quick_syntax_check
description: Perform a lightweight syntax check on a small set of files (lighter than validate_file).

name: create_plan
description: Break a goal description into a multi-step execution plan.

fields.example: 重构 login 模块，使其支持模块化 session 管理并 >= 80% 单元测试覆盖率

returns: (ok, message). message is the structured description of the plan.

name: revise_plan
description: Re-generate the existing plan based on a new reason or a new step list.

fields.example: 用户要求改用 redis 作为 session 后端

1. 增加 redis 依赖
2. 实现 RedisSessionStore

name: show_plan
description: Display the current multi-agent execution plan (including progress percentage). no parameters.

name: run_agents
description: Start multi-agent parallel execution based on the existing plan; mode (full/dry/step) can be specified.

name: agent_progress
description: Display the current overall progress of multi-agent execution (completed steps / total steps). no parameters.

name: mark_step_done
description: Mark the Nth step in the plan as complete.

name: sklii_call
description: Invoke a registered sklii tool.

name: sklii_create
description: Create and register a new custom skill/tool in the current project's sklii toolkit. You are allowed to create skills by yourself when the user asks or when it improves the workflow. Currently supports 'http' and 'mcp' type skills (no local python/shell runners).

fields.example: 校验 JSON schema 是否匹配当前数据结构

fields.note: each item must contain at least 'name' and 'run' or 'type' to be callable

name: sklii_list
description: List all sklii tools registered by the current project. no parameters.

name: git_status
description: Run git status --short; returns a summary of current workspace changes. no parameters.

name: git_diff
description: Run git diff; optionally pass --cached or a single file path.

name: git_commit
description: Run git add . && git commit -m <message>. A non-empty message is required.

fields.example: refactor(login): 模块化 session 管理

returns: (ok, message). ok reflects the git commit exit code.

name: git_branch
description: List local branches and their latest commit summary. no parameters.

name: git_log
description: Display the latest n commits (oneline).

name: git_checkout
description: Switch branch (git checkout <branch>). The 'branch' field only allows letters, digits, /, ., _, and -.
returns: (ok, message). ok reflects the git checkout exit code.

name: view_image
description: View an image's metadata (dimensions, format); no OCR is performed.
returns: (ok, message). message contains format / size / mode.

name: list_uploaded_images
description: List all images uploaded during this session along with their metadata. no parameters.

name: parse_document_text
description: Parse the plain text contents of a document (PDF/DOCX/TXT etc.).
returns: (ok, message). message is the document's plain text (size-limited).

name: parse_document_images
description: Extract all images from a document (no OCR; returns image count and brief info).

name: parse_document
description: Combined parsing: returns the document's plain text + metadata such as image count.

name: record_lesson
description: Store one lesson per file with a one-line summary. Record corrections and confirmed approaches, including why they mattered. Update existing notes rather than creating duplicates.

fields.example: Fix: auth middleware must check token expiry before DB lookup
fields.note: one-line summary used as the filename

fields.example: When the auth middleware runs, always check JWT expiry first. If it's expired, return 401 without hitting the DB. This prevents unnecessary DB load and avoids stale-user errors.

returns: (ok, message). Creates or updates a lesson file in .dscode/lessons/.

name: list_lessons
description: List all stored lessons/notes. Optionally filter by tag or search keyword.

fields.note: search in lesson titles and content

returns: (ok, message). message is a formatted list of lesson titles and summaries.

name: delete_lesson
description: Delete a lesson by its title. Use this when a saved note turns out to be wrong or no longer relevant.

fields.example: Fix: auth middleware must check token expiry before DB lookup
fields.note: exact title of the lesson to delete

returns: (ok, message). Deletes the lesson file from .dscode/lessons/.

name: set_conversation_title
description: Set the visible title of the current conversation once you understand what the user is building. If the user has already manually renamed the conversation, this tool will be rejected. Call it sparingly (usually after the first meaningful user request).
returns: (ok, message). Updates the conversation display name in the sidebar.

name: git_add
description: Stage project files.

name: git_branch_create
description: Create a project Git branch.

name: git_branch_delete
description: Delete a Git branch; reviewer and read-only agents cannot use this.

name: git_reset
description: Reset Git index/worktree. Choose soft, mixed or hard explicitly.

name: git_stash
description: Save or restore worktree changes using Git stash.

name: replace_symbol_in_files
description: Replace a symbol using the sandbox text fallback.

name: shell_start
description: Start an owned persistent shell inside the project.

name: shell_exec
description: Run a command in the persistent shell and wait for its exit status.

name: shell_send
description: Send a command to the persistent shell without waiting.

name: shell_read
description: Read buffered persistent shell output.

name: shell_cd
description: Change the persistent shell directory inside the project.

name: shell_stop
description: Stop the owned persistent shell and its child processes.

name: goto_definition
description: Resolve a symbol definition using LSP or local fallback.

name: find_references
description: Find references to a symbol; positions are one-based.

name: hover_info
description: Get documentation/type information for a symbol.

name: get_diagnostics
description: Read LSP diagnostics for a file.

name: document_symbols
description: List symbols in a document.

name: format_document
description: Format a document using LSP or local fallback.
